Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to return the trashed card from my trash to my hand if 1 [Mirei Mikagura] or 1 card with the [Angel], [Archangel], or [Fallen Angel] trait is trashed from my hand?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may trash 1 card in your hand. If you do, you may return 1 [Mirei Mikagura] or 1 card with [Angel], [Archangel], or [Fallen Angel] in its traits from your trash to your hand.
[Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When you play [Angewomon] or [Mirei Mikagura], gain 1 memory.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] While you have a yellow Digimon in play, all of your Digimon with [Angel], [Archangel], or [Fallen Angel] in their traits gain ＜Retaliation＞.
